name: Ash Crescent Play Area
description: Fenced play area reached from Larch Road or between 63 and 65 Ash Crescent, with a combined slide and climbing frame, balance beam, traverse wall and rope walk for older children, and swings and springers for toddlers, as Eckington Parish Council describes it.
operator: Eckington Parish Council (inspected by North East Derbyshire District Council)
